description: This file contains the code-behind for the TheorySet page in an Online Examination System. It manages UI interactions such as course selection, question addition, exam setup, and navigation between pages. It interacts with a SQL database to store and retrieve question and course details.

classes.name: TheorySet
classes.description: Code-behind class for the TheorySet Web Forms page handling examination questions, course selection, and navigation in the online exam system

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial load event of the page; currently commented out, likely for session or info initialization

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Admin Panel page

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Admin Queue page

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Admin Leaderboard page

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on the selected semester

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new theory question to the database and updates question number; displays an alert on completion

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Sets up a new exam for the selected course in the database and transfers to the Admin Panel

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by transferring to the Login Page

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates course options when semester selection changes

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates question number based on selected course
